status: INTERIM. Every file is a 414 x 414 px Facebook thumbnail. Usable for gallery thumbnails and small cards at 1x only. Full-resolution originals are required from Sam for every image before launch (see docs/placeholders.md).
rules: No location, town, cove or customer is known for any photo. Never caption a photo with a place name.
No stock or AI-generated image may be added to this folder.
Alt text describes the work (material and method), never the mood.

brand.description: The logo badge: bearded mason with folded arms, American flag, stone fireplace with mounted buck, trowel, John 3:16 tattoo; wordmark SHEWMAKER BROTHERS in a heavy condensed slab. Square Facebook crop; the MASONRY line is cut off at the bottom.
brand.needs: Vector source, a simplified small-size mark and a one-colour version.

images.alt: Eroded lakefront bank of exposed rock and clay beneath a white deck and stairs, before a stone retaining wall
images.title: Failed bank under a deck, before
images.caption: Bare bank of stone and red clay under the deck, no wall.
images.description: Before: the failed bank under a lake house deck, exposed rock and red clay, no wall.

images.alt: Mortared fieldstone lakefront retaining wall below a white deck, two crew members working on top
images.title: Lakefront retaining wall, after
images.caption: Mortared multicolour fieldstone retaining wall on a poured footing.
images.description: After: mortared multicolour fieldstone retaining wall built below the same deck, crew on top, boulder in front.

images.alt: Corner of a mortared fieldstone retaining wall showing joint work and the poured concrete footing at its base
images.title: Wall corner and footing
images.caption: Grey mortar joints, tan and rust fieldstone, concrete footing at the base.
images.description: Detail: wall corner, grey mortar joints, tan and rust fieldstone, fresh concrete footing visible at the base.

images.alt: Wide view of an eroded lakefront slope with exposed roots below a deck, a crew member working among boulders
images.title: Eroded slope, before
images.caption: Exposed roots and rubble under the deck before the rebuild.
images.description: Before, wide: exposed roots and rubble under the deck, cables strung for the rebuild, crew member on the boulders.

images.alt: Undercut, eroding shoreline seen from the water with a white lake house above and a dock float in the foreground
images.title: Undercut shoreline, before
images.caption: Undercut bank at the waterline, seen from the water.
images.description: Before, from the water: the undercut bank at the waterline with the lake house above; water in frame.

images.alt: Long run of finished mortared stone seawall along a beach with a lake house above and the water at right
images.title: Stone seawall along the shore
images.caption: Mortared stone seawall on a poured footing, lake house above.
images.description: Finished mortared stone seawall along the shore, lake house above, crew member at left, water at right. Strongest seawall wide in the set.

images.alt: Mason smoothing the poured concrete cap on the end of a mortared stone seawall, covered docks and the lake behind
images.title: Finishing the seawall cap
images.caption: Poured concrete cap being floated on a seawall return.
images.description: Crew finishing the concrete cap on a seawall return; docks and open water behind. Shows the cap detail and the crew at work.

images.alt: Finished mortared stone seawall in front of a lake house with a screened porch, stone stairs to the right, on a sunny day
images.title: Seawall with stone stairs
images.caption: Mortared stone seawall with stone stairs at the right end.
images.description: Finished seawall at a lake house with a screened porch; stone stairs at the right end; sun on the stone.

images.alt: Mortared stone retaining wall with an integrated flight of stone stairs with concrete-capped treads, houses behind
images.title: Retaining wall with built-in stairs
images.caption: Mortared stone retaining wall with stone stairs and poured treads.
images.description: Retaining wall with built-in stone stairs and poured treads (drone frame, DJI_0325). Bare graded ground in front.

images.alt: Mortared fieldstone retaining wall with a concrete drainage swale running down the slope between two houses
images.title: Retaining wall with drainage swale
images.caption: Mortared fieldstone wall with a concrete drainage swale through it.
images.description: Retaining wall with a concrete-lined drainage channel through it (drone frame, DJI_0328). Shows water management, not just the wall.

images.alt: Crew of four hand-digging the footing trench along a shoreline for a stone seawall, docks and the lake behind
images.title: Digging the seawall footing
images.caption: Footing trench hand-dug along the shoreline before the pour.
images.description: Crew digging the seawall footing trench by hand along the shore; docks and open water behind. The 'built on a footing' proof shot.

images.alt: Low stone wall with large grey stone faces and dark mortar joints, cap freshly poured, rebar dowels standing
images.title: Low stone wall, cap poured
images.caption: Large grey stone faces, dark mortar joints, fresh cap with rebar dowels.
images.description: In progress: low wall with big grey stone faces, dark joints, fresh cap, rebar in place. Same site as the flagstone patio photo.

images.alt: Flagstone slabs laid out on the grass for a patio in front of a low mortared stone wall with a fresh cap, lake house behind
images.title: Flagstone patio, in progress
images.caption: Flagstone laid out for a patio at the foot of a new stone wall.
images.description: In progress: flagstone being laid out for a patio at the foot of a new low stone wall; lake house with covered porch behind.

images.alt: Close view of stone stairs with mortared fieldstone risers and smooth poured concrete treads beside a stone wall
images.title: Stone stairs with concrete treads
images.caption: Mortared fieldstone risers with poured concrete treads.
images.description: Detail: fieldstone risers with poured concrete treads climbing beside a stone wall. Shows the stone-and-concrete combination.

images.alt: Outdoor stone fireplace with a pizza oven above and a built-in grill beside it, on a flagstone patio under trees
images.title: Fireplace, pizza oven and grill
images.caption: Stone veneer fireplace, pizza oven and built-in grill on flagstone.
images.description: The fireplace, pizza oven and built-in crank grill in multicolour stone veneer on a flagstone patio. The brand board's best single asset.

images.alt: Floor-to-ceiling stacked stone veneer fireplace with a rustic timber mantel and a raised concrete hearth
images.title: Stacked stone indoor fireplace
images.caption: Full-height ledgestone veneer, timber mantel, raised concrete hearth.
images.description: Indoor fireplace: full-height ledgestone veneer in white, grey and tan, timber mantel, raised hearth.

images.alt: Interior doorway framed in brick with a segmental brick arch, opening into an office
images.title: Brick doorway with segmental arch
images.caption: Brick doorway with a segmental arch, laid in an office interior.
images.description: Brick doorway with a segmental arch inside an office. The only brick and the only commercial-looking interior in the set.
